description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = small” illustrates word error rate (WER) over training epochs for four configurations listed in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 25 to 42.5 with regularly spaced tick labels every 2.5 units. Four orange lines are shown: (1) “small AdaLoRA_int4” is a solid line with circle markers, decreasing steadily from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to about 30.5 at epoch 6, passing through approximately 34.7 (epoch 1), 33.8 (epoch 2), 32.9 (epoch 3), 32.1 (epoch 4), and 31.3 (epoch 5). (2) “small AdaLoRA_int8” is a solid line with square markers, trending downward overall from about 30.0 at epoch 0 to about 25.0 at epoch 6, with intermediate values near 29.8 (epoch 1), 28.6 (epoch 2), 28.1 (epoch 3), 27.3 (epoch 4), and 26.5 (epoch 5). (3) The third series (legend entry shown as a dashed orange line with circle markers) rises from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to a peak near 42.2 at epoch 2, then declines to about 31.5 by epoch 6, with points around 40.1 (epoch 1), 38.7 (epoch 3), 36.3 (epoch 4), and 34.0 (epoch 5). (4) “small int8” is a dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 30.0 at epoch 0 to about 33.7 at epoch 2, then dropping to about 25.4 at epoch 5 and ending near 26.0 at epoch 6, with intermediate values around 33.2 (epoch 1), 29.5 (epoch 3), and 27.3 (epoch 4).
